text: This was the most impressive teeth scaling experience I've ever had using my social security benefits for 900 baht. It was painless, the scaling was done well, and the dentist was attentive, polishing and detailing every tooth. I had some bothersome stains on my teeth from my braces (buckets) that other dentists would have noticed but wouldn't have mentioned. But at this clinic, the dentist asked if I had ever had braces and said they would remove the stains without me even asking (this requires a different set of tools than for scaling: removing stains and polishing the tooth surface). There were no additional charges.

I had my teeth scaled by a male doctor. I felt that he had a heavy hand. I'm not sure if it's normal for teeth scales to bleed, but mine did. It was a bit painful, but the nurses were kind and friendly.
Great dentist. Been coming for years.
Excellent quality and service but parking can be challenging.
